coverage_claim: A source-grounded reviewable draft of a court, tribunal or arbitration case across Akoma Ntoso, ECLI, UNCITRAL and HCCH instruments, PROV-O and OWL-Time, without universal procedure, automated adjudication, legal-advice, outcome-prediction or certified crosswalk claims.

boundary_decision.status: accepted as a forum-qualified case aggregate with governed child records
boundary_decision.rationale: The case owns docket identity, procedural history, forum and party-role bindings, schedules, rulings and child composition. WM-POL-019 filings, WM-POL-020 evidence and WM-POL-021 decisions preserve their own identity and lifecycle; forums, parties, disputes, remedies, reviews and enforcement remain external masters.

decisions.rationale: A court, tribunal or arbitral institution is an organization with competence; a case is one proceeding in its docket or administration.
They share a case-record pattern but jurisdiction basis, seat, confidentiality, publication, appeal, set-aside and enforcement cannot be flattened.
WM-POL-019, WM-POL-020 and WM-POL-021 own filings, evidence items and decisions, while the case owns membership and case-specific use.
Allegations, claims, submitted evidence, admission rulings, credibility assessments and findings of fact remain separately attributable.
Transmission, receipt and legally effective service may differ, and every deadline records trigger, calendar, timezone, extension and compliance.
Issuance, correction, finality, appeal, set-aside, recognition, enforcement and satisfaction may occur in different proceedings and times.
Public court records, sealed matters and confidential arbitration require purpose, authority, redaction and re-identification controls.
Akoma Ntoso, ECLI, LegalRuleML and provenance models identify different resources and cannot replace authoritative docket state.
Agents may maintain records and propose validations but cannot decide merits, predict a legally correct outcome or issue legal advice.

publication_holds: Claude and Grok timed out during their bounded attempts, so independent external review is absent and explicitly waived for this published reviewable draft.
Candidate CONTAINS relations to WM-POL-019, WM-POL-020 and WM-POL-021 still require approved cardinality, access and lifecycle contracts.
Jurisdiction-specific civil, criminal, administrative, constitutional, family, insolvency, appellate and arbitral procedure profiles require specialist review.
Certified Akoma Ntoso, ECLI, LegalRuleML and court-system crosswalks and conformance fixtures remain unverified.
